entries.0d3ab7c1b004223d: This is the banking business carried out by SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited, SBI Savings Bank Co., Ltd. in Korea and others. SBI Shinsei Bank became a subsidiary through the acquisition of shares in December 2021, and as of March 31, 2026, the company's voting rights ownership ratio was 71.2%. In July 2025 it fully repaid public funds, and in December 2025 it was relisted on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. SBI Savings Bank Co., Ltd. (headquartered in Korea) became a subsidiary through the acquisition of shares in March 2013, with a voting rights ownership ratio of 90.0%. Sumishin SBI Net Bank, Ltd., which opened in 2007, was removed from the equity-method affiliates after its shares were transferred in October 2025.

entries.1400b8f46c9eb776: This is one of the reportable segments and includes the following businesses. In addition to the Bio, Healthcare and Medical Informatics Business, which develops and sells pharmaceuticals, health foods and cosmetics using natural amino acid 5-ALA (5-aminolevulinic acid), it includes businesses tackling advanced Web3-related fields, renewable energy, human resources and media. Consolidated subsidiaries include SBI Pharma Co., Ltd., SBI Alapromo Co., Ltd., SBI Biotech Co., Ltd. and SBI NeoMedia Holdings Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership ratio of 80.0%), and equity-method affiliates include Mynavi Corporation (20.0%, became an equity-method affiliate in November 2024). The Web3-related business acquires and holds crypto assets as validator rewards. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥51,519 million, the fourth largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 83.2% year on year to ¥56,182 million.
entries.192e12437280f9c9: This business invests in ventures in Japan and overseas in areas including IT, fintech, AI and big data, blockchain, finance and biotechnology. It is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries including SBI Capital Management Co., Ltd., SBI Investment Co., Ltd., SBI Hong Kong Holdings Co., Limited and SBI VENTURES SINGAPORE PTE. LTD., as well as investment limited partnerships. Investment limited partnerships in which the voting rights ownership ratio is 50% or less are also made subsidiaries because the group controls them. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥155,757 million, the second largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 12.4% year on year to ¥158,282 million. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, there were 17 IPOs, M&A transactions and other exits involving investee companies. From the first consolidated cumulative quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2026, the former name “Investment Business” was changed to “PE Investment Business.”

entries.7776cfbb4d14c4cf: This is the group's core business, which carries out diverse finance-related businesses centered on securities-related, banking, and insurance businesses in Japan and overseas. Consolidated subsidiaries as of March 31, 2026 include SBI Securities Co., Ltd., SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited (71.2% ownership of voting rights), SBI Insurance Group Co., Ltd. (59.7%), SBI Life Insurance Co., Ltd., SBI Insurance Co., Ltd., SBI Arhi Co., Ltd. (63.0%), and SBI Savings Bank of South Korea (90.0%). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,569,773 million, the largest among the 5 reporting segments, and revenue including transactions between segments was ¥1,582,508 million, up 34.8% from the previous fiscal year. The group's customer base in Japan and overseas was 82.56 million accounts as of the end of March 2026, of which approximately 5,000 ten-thousand were in Japan and approximately 32.74 million were overseas, centered on TPBank and SBI Savings Bank. In addition, some securities investments that had been included in the Financial Services Business until the previous fiscal year have been included in the PE Investment Business from the second quarter cumulative period of the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.7863e2f84bc5bd57: This business provides crypto asset exchange and trading services as a crypto asset exchange service provider and others. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary SBI VC Trade Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership ratio of 100.0%, all held indirectly) and B2C2 LTD in the United Kingdom (90.0%, all held indirectly). SBI VC Trade has also obtained licenses for electronic payment instrument transaction services and Type I financial instruments business, in addition to crypto asset exchange services. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥89,319 million, the third largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 10.9% year on year to ¥89,615 million, a record high. The company cites fluctuations in crypto asset prices and other factors. SBI VC Trade has expanded its retail customer base through M&A and is also strengthening its business for corporate clients.
entries.7b0874e5223b29da: This business provides investment management, including the establishment, offering and management of investment trusts, as well as investment advisory services and the provision of financial product information. It is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries including SBI Asset Management Group Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership ratio of 100.0%), SBI Global Asset Management Co., Ltd. (57.6%) and SBI Asset Management Co., Ltd. (97.9%). SBI Global Asset Management originated from Morningstar Co., Ltd., whose shares were acquired in July 2004. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥40,356 million, the smallest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 23.1% year on year to ¥41,634 million, and the company cites growth in assets under management at each company against a backdrop of a strong domestic stock market as a factor. The company is strengthening its product and service delivery through alliances with leading global asset managers and by using AI agents to manage risk and improve operational efficiency.
entries.8d43af185077469e: This is the insurance business carried out by SBI Insurance Group Co., Ltd., SBI Life Insurance Co., Ltd., SBI Non-Life Insurance Co., Ltd. and others. As of March 31, 2026, the voting rights ownership ratios were 59.7% for SBI Insurance Group, 100.0% for SBI Life Insurance (all held indirectly) and 99.2% for SBI Non-Life Insurance (all held indirectly). SBI Insurance Group listed on the Mothers market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in September 2018. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company explains that the number of insurance policies in force grew steadily. Kyobo Life Insurance Co., Ltd. in Korea is an equity-method affiliate (voting rights ownership ratio of 20.4%) and is classified under the Financial Services Business.
